translation: The treatise on the Three Wastings (三消) was written by Liu Hejian (劉河間). Because the Admonisher Ma (麻徵君) was residing in Bianliang (汴梁), on a day of leisure he visited the descendants of the Master; one who was engaged in teaching medicine was that very person. The Admonisher went to his house and sought the works that the Master had written in his lifetime.
translator_notes: 遺害 likely a typo for 遺稿 (surviving manuscripts); rendered as 'works written in his lifetime'.
